data.name: Expand_Intro
data.value: Runs on the target files after Copy to Target Languages, and restructures every ICU plural message into one segment per form the target language needs, each a whole sentence with a comment saying which counts select it. The message's syntax is protected, so a translator cannot damage it.
data.comment: Paragraph at the top of the page.

data.name: Expand_KindsHeader
data.comment: Group heading. Which kinds of ICU message the task restructures.

data.name: Expand_KindsHelpHeader
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel. Phrased as the question a puzzled user would ask.

data.name: Expand_KindsHelp1
data.value: A plural message in the source has as many forms as the source language needs: two for English, "one" and "other". The target language may need more. Russian needs four, Arabic six, Japanese one. Expanding gives the translator exactly the forms the target needs, each as a complete sentence, instead of a brace expression to edit by hand.
data.comment: Help paragraph. "one" and "other" are ICU keywords and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_KindsHelp2
data.value: Select messages, which choose by a value such as gender rather than by a count, are never expanded: their branches are the developer's, not the language's. They are still restructured so that their syntax is protected and each branch is a sentence.
data.comment: Help paragraph. "select" is the ICU keyword.

data.name: Expand_Cardinal
data.comment: Tick box. The bracketed part is ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_Ordinal
data.comment: Tick box. Ordinals are 1st, 2nd, 3rd. The bracketed part is ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_KindsHint
data.value: Each message becomes one segment per form the target language needs, each a whole sentence. A message of a kind that is not ticked is left as it is.
data.comment: Hint under the two tick boxes.

data.name: Expand_SeedHeader
data.value: Source text for forms the source language does not have
data.comment: Group heading. English has two plural forms; Russian needs four, so two of the Russian segments have no exact English counterpart and start from an English form chosen here.

data.name: Expand_SeedMatching
data.value: The source form with the same name where there is one, otherwise the "other" form
data.comment: Radio button, the default. "other" is the ICU keyword and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_SeedAlwaysOther
data.comment: Radio button. "other" is the ICU keyword and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_SeedHint
data.value: The comment on each segment says which source form it started from, so the translator knows when the source is only a starting point.
data.comment: Hint under the two radio buttons.

data.name: Expand_SeedHelpHeader
data.value: Where does the text for an extra form come from?
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Expand_SeedHelp1
data.value: English has a "one" form and an "other" form. A Russian "few" form has no English counterpart, so its segment has to start from one of the English forms, and that text is what the translator sees as the source.
data.comment: Help paragraph. "one", "other" and "few" are ICU keywords and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_SeedHelp2
data.value: With the first choice a target form starts from the source form of the same name where there is one, otherwise from "other". With the second every form starts from "other", which some teams prefer because the English "one" form is often worded for exactly one item and reads oddly as the source for anything else.
data.comment: Help paragraph. "one" and "other" are ICU keywords and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_PlaceholdersHeader
data.comment: Group heading. The arguments and the count marker inside a segment.

data.name: Expand_LockPlaceholders
data.value: Lock the placeholders so they cannot be moved or deleted
data.comment: Tick box. Off by default.

data.name: Expand_LockHint
data.value: Each argument and the count marker is a tag inside the segment. Unlocked, it can be placed with QuickPlace or Ctrl+Alt+Down, and a missing one is reported by the ICU Verifier and the tag verifier. Locked, it cannot be deleted or moved, and it drops out of QuickPlace.
data.comment: Hint under the tick box. QuickPlace is Studio's feature name.

data.name: Expand_PlaceholdersHelpHeader
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Expand_PlaceholdersHelp1
data.value: An argument such as {name} and the count marker # must reach the translation exactly as they are, wherever the language wants them. As tags they behave like any tag in Studio: QuickPlace and Ctrl+Alt+Down insert them, the translation memory recognises them, and the tag verifier and the ICU Verifier report one that is missing or extra.
data.comment: Help paragraph. Keep {name} and #.

data.name: Expand_PlaceholdersHelp2
data.value: Locking wraps each tag so it cannot be deleted or moved by mistake, which suits a team that copies the source and translates around the tags. The cost is that a locked tag cannot be placed by QuickPlace, so a form typed from scratch or filled from a fuzzy match has to start from the source. Off is the default.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHeader
data.comment: Group heading. A cap on how many segments one message may become.

data.name: Expand_BudgetLabel
data.value: Most segments one message may expand to:
data.comment: Label before a number box. The default is 24.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHint
data.value: Two independent plurals multiply: six forms times six forms is 36 segments for Arabic. Over the budget the message is laid out with its syntax protected but no forms added, and the report says so.
data.comment: Hint under the number box.

data.name: Expand_BudgetInvalid
data.value: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
data.comment: Validation message shown when the number box holds something else.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHelpHeader
data.value: What is the branch budget for?
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHelp1
data.value: A message with two independent plurals multiplies: the forms of one times the forms of the other. Six times six is 36 segments for Arabic from a single message, which is a lot to translate and usually a sign that the developer should split the message.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHelp2
data.value: Over the budget the message is still restructured with its syntax protected and its original branches, but no forms are added. The paragraph carries a warning and the report lists it, so the translator cannot damage the message and the project manager knows the language may lack forms it needs.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Expand_ParseHeader
data.value: When a value does not parse as an ICU message
data.comment: Group heading. What the task does with a value that has braces but is not valid ICU.

data.name: Expand_ParsePassThrough
data.value: Leave it untouched and add a warning
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Expand_ParseFail
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first such value.

data.name: Expand_ParseHelpHeader
data.value: When does a value fail to parse?
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Expand_ParseHelp1
data.value: A brace without its partner, an apostrophe placed where ICU reads it as the start of a quoted literal, a selector keyword misspelt. Such a value cannot be restructured because its structure is unknown.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Expand_ParseHelp2
data.value: Leaving it untouched keeps the rest of the file moving and marks the paragraph with a warning that names the position of the problem. Stopping the task is for a pipeline where a broken message must never reach a translator unnoticed.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Finalise_Intro
data.value: Finalise prunes each message to the forms the target language needs, escapes ICU special characters typed as text, and checks the placeholders. Warnings go on the source segment's comment and into the task report; target comments are never written.
data.comment: Paragraph at the top of the page.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyHeader
data.value: When a form has no translation
data.comment: Group heading. A required segment whose target is empty.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyUseSource
data.value: Use the source text and add a warning
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyFail
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first empty form.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyHelpHeader
data.value: What happens to a form nobody translated?
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyHelp1
data.value: Every form the target language needs must be present in the generated file, or the application shows nothing at all for the counts that select it. Using the source text keeps the file valid and marks the source segment's comment and the report, so the gap can be found later.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyHelp2
data.value: Stopping the task is for a final delivery, where an untranslated form must not slip through in the source language.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchHeader
data.value: When the protected placeholders in source and target differ
data.comment: Group heading. A placeholder such as {name} missing from the translation or added to it.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchWarn
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchFail
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first mismatch.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchHelpHeader
data.comment: Header of a collapsible help panel.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchHelp1
data.value: The protected spans in a segment are the message's arguments, such as {name}, and the count marker #. A translation that has lost one, or gained one the source does not have, fails or shows the wrong text when the application runs.
data.comment: Help paragraph. "{name}" and "#" are ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchHelp2
data.value: A warning goes on the source segment's comment and into the report, and the file is still generated. Stopping the task refuses to generate until the translation is put right.
data.comment: Help paragraph.

data.name: Report_ExpandName
data.comment: Report name and title, one per language pair. Same wording as the task name in Studio's batch task list.

data.name: Report_ExpandDescription
data.value: {0} ICU message(s) expanded in {1} file(s); {2} with a warning.
data.comment: One-line description shown beside the report in Studio's Reports view. {0} messages, {1} files, {2} warnings; keep the placeholders.

data.name: Report_FinaliseName
data.comment: Report name and title, one per language pair. Same wording as the task name.

data.name: Report_FinaliseDescription
data.value: {0} ICU message(s) finalised in {1} file(s); {2} form(s) removed, {3} segment(s) filled from the source, {4} warning(s).
data.comment: One-line description shown beside the report. {0} messages, {1} files, {2} forms removed, {3} segments filled, {4} warnings; keep the placeholders.

data.name: Report_Summary
data.comment: Report heading, as in Studio's own reports.

data.name: Report_Project
data.comment: Row label in the summary.

data.name: Report_Languages
data.comment: Row label in the summary: source and target language of the report.

data.name: Report_Files
data.comment: Row label in the summary: number of files covered.

data.name: Report_CreatedAt
data.comment: Row label in the summary: when the task ran.

data.name: Report_Cldr
data.comment: Row label in the summary. The value is the CLDR version the plural rules came from, such as "CLDR 47 (Unicode 16.0)".

data.name: Report_Settings
data.comment: Report heading: the settings the task ran with.

data.name: Report_Totals
data.comment: Report heading over the per-file table.

data.name: Report_File
data.comment: Column title.

data.name: Report_Messages
data.comment: Column title: number of ICU messages in the file.

data.name: Report_Segments
data.comment: Column title: number of Studio segments.

data.name: Report_Warnings
data.comment: Column title and report heading.

data.name: Report_Details
data.comment: Report heading over the per-message tables.

data.name: Report_Key
data.comment: Column title: the resource key of a message, such as inbox.unreadCount.

data.name: Report_Total
data.comment: Row label of the totals row.

data.name: Report_Outcome
data.comment: Column title: what the expand task did with the message.

data.name: Report_Note
data.comment: Column title: the warning text where there is one.

data.name: Report_Expanded
data.comment: Outcome and column title: one segment per form the target language needs.

data.name: Report_Protected
data.comment: Outcome and column title: no plural, the arguments were protected in one segment.

data.name: Report_Walked
data.comment: Outcome and column title: the message exceeded the branch budget and was laid out with its syntax protected but no forms added.

data.name: Report_PassedThrough
data.comment: Outcome and column title: left untouched with a warning.

data.name: Report_Skipped
data.comment: Outcome and column title: expanded by an earlier run and left alone.

data.name: Report_Pruned
data.comment: Column title in the finalise report: plural forms removed because the target language does not use them.

data.name: Report_Filled
data.comment: Column title in the finalise report: untranslated segments filled with the source text.

data.name: Report_NoWarnings
data.comment: Shown under the Warnings heading when there are none.

data.name: Report_On
data.comment: Value of a tick-box setting in the report's settings table.

data.name: Report_Off
data.comment: Value of a tick-box setting in the report's settings table.

data.name: Forms_Purpose
data.value: ICU Forms shows every plural, ordinal and select form of an ICU MessageFormat message with sample counts, and the whole message reassembled, so a translation can be checked while it is typed.
data.comment: Body of the empty states: what the window is for. "ICU MessageFormat" is a technology name and stays as it is.

data.name: Forms_NoDocumentTitle
data.comment: Title of the empty state when the editor has no document.

data.name: Forms_NoDocument
data.value: Open a JSON or Java properties file that ICU Expand Plural Forms has processed, and move to a segment of a plural message.
data.comment: Note of the empty state when the editor has no document. "ICU Expand Plural Forms" is the batch task's name as Studio lists it.

data.name: Forms_UnsupportedTitle
data.comment: Title of the empty state when the open file is of a file type the plugin does not handle.

data.name: Forms_UnsupportedWhy
data.value: It works with Studio's JSON and Java Resources file types, the two the ICU tasks are proven on. This file uses the file type "{0}", which the ICU tasks do not process, so there are no forms to show.
data.comment: Note of the unsupported-file state. {0} is Studio's file type identifier, such as "Word 2007-2019 v 1.0.0.0"; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Forms_UnsupportedUnknown
data.value: It works with Studio's JSON and Java Resources file types, the two the ICU tasks are proven on. This file is of another type, which the ICU tasks do not process, so there are no forms to show.
data.comment: Note of the unsupported-file state when Studio reports no file type identifier for the file.

data.name: Forms_NotExpandedTitle
data.value: No ICU messages expanded in this file
data.comment: Title of the empty state when the file is a supported type but the expand task has not run on it.

data.name: Forms_NotExpanded
data.value: Run ICU Expand Plural Forms on this file before translating it, then open it again. Until then the plural messages are single segments of brace syntax.
data.comment: Note of the not-expanded state. "ICU Expand Plural Forms" is the batch task's name.

data.name: Forms_NotIcuTitle
data.comment: Title of the empty state when the selected segment belongs to an ordinary paragraph of an expanded file.

data.name: Forms_NotIcu
data.value: The active segment is ordinary text with nothing to expand. Move to a segment of a plural, ordinal or select message and its forms appear here.
data.comment: Note of the not-an-ICU-message state.

data.name: Forms_Summary
data.comment: Line under the message key. {0} is the target language name, {1} the number of forms; keep the placeholders.

data.name: Forms_ColumnForm
data.comment: Column title: the plural form, explicit value or select key of the row.

data.name: Forms_ColumnCounts
data.comment: Column title: example counts that select the form.

data.name: Forms_ColumnSource
data.comment: Column title: the source sentence with sample values.

data.name: Forms_ColumnTarget
data.comment: Column title: the translation with sample values.

data.name: Forms_FractionalOnly
data.comment: Appended to the counts of a form only fractional numbers select, such as Russian "other".

data.name: Forms_EmptyTarget
data.comment: Shown in the Target column for a form with no translation yet.

data.name: Forms_TryCount
data.comment: Label before a small box where the translator types a number to see which form it selects.

data.name: Forms_ResolvesTo
data.comment: Result beside the count box. {0} is the form name, such as "few" or "=0"; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Forms_ResolvesNothing
data.comment: Result beside the count box when the text is not a number or the message has no plural.

data.name: Forms_Projection
data.comment: Label over the read-only box showing the whole target message as it will be written to the file.

data.name: Forms_Parses
data.comment: Status beside the reassembled message when it parses.

data.name: Forms_ParseError
data.comment: Status beside the reassembled message when it does not parse. {0} is the parser's description; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Forms_PlaceholderWarning
data.comment: Tooltip on a target cell whose protected placeholders differ from the source. {0} lists what is missing or extra; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Forms_ZoomIn
data.comment: Tooltip of the plus button in the window's corner.

data.name: Forms_ZoomOut
data.comment: Tooltip of the minus button in the window's corner.

data.name: Forms_ZoomReset
data.comment: Tooltip of the button showing the current zoom, which resets it when clicked.

data.name: Verifier_Origin
data.comment: The Origin column of the Messages window. Same wording as the verifier's name in the Verification settings.

data.name: Verifier_EmptyForm
data.value: The form "{0}" has no translation; Finalise will use the source text.
data.comment: Warning. {0} is the form's path, such as "count:few"; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Verifier_Placeholders
data.value: The protected placeholders differ from the source: {0}.
data.comment: Error. {0} lists what is missing or extra, such as "missing {name}"; keep the placeholder.

data.name: Verifier_TypedPound
data.value: A '#' typed as text will be shown literally; use the protected # for the count.
data.comment: Warning. '#' is ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Verifier_Invalid
data.value: The reassembled message is not valid ICU: {0}.
data.comment: Error. {0} is the parser's description of the problem; keep the placeholder.

data.name: VerifierPage_Intro
data.value: The ICU verifier checks every form of an expanded ICU message when you press F8 and as segments are confirmed, and lists what it finds in the Messages window.
data.comment: Paragraph at the top of the verifier's settings page.

data.name: VerifierPage_Enabled
data.comment: Tick box, on by default, as every Studio verifier's page offers.

data.name: VerifierPage_SeverityHeader
data.comment: Heading over the list of checks, each with a severity choice beside it.

data.name: VerifierPage_CheckEmptyForm
data.comment: One of the four checks. Its severity is chosen in a drop-down beside it.

data.name: VerifierPage_CheckPlaceholders
data.value: Placeholders that differ from the source
data.comment: One of the four checks.

data.name: VerifierPage_CheckTypedPound
data.value: A count marker typed as text
data.comment: One of the four checks. The count marker is the ICU '#'.

data.name: VerifierPage_CheckInvalid
data.value: A reassembled message that will not parse
data.comment: One of the four checks.

data.name: VerifierPage_Hint
data.value: Error, Warning and Note are Studio's message severities. "Do not report" drops the finding altogether.
data.comment: Hint under the checks. "Error", "Warning" and "Note" follow Studio's own translation of its message severities.

data.name: Severity_Error
data.comment: A severity choice; follow Studio's own translation.

data.name: Severity_Warning
data.comment: A severity choice; follow Studio's own translation.

data.name: Severity_Note
data.comment: A severity choice; follow Studio's own translation.

data.name: Severity_Ignore
data.comment: A severity choice that drops the finding.
